specs.title: one real port HOME, four reachable circles, one launch, actual layered PNG decoding and no dock tabs

touch cancellation, occupied selection and keyboard rotation save only the confirmed geometry
real browser close and persistent-profile restart retain fleet, upgrades, tasks and wallet
18px text, synthetic safe spaces, short screen and keyboard keep the four actions and launch usable
export/import stays explicit, malformed data never changes saved rights or other game namespaces
route preview, reload and secondary history preserve the true quotation and never reveal future signals
